questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Reliable renewable energy requires planning for variable supply and demand.
options: Reliable renewable energy requires planning for variable supply and demand.
A battery can store an unlimited amount of energy.
Wind turbines produce identical amounts at all times.
The cheapest device always creates the best complete system.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Reliable renewable energy requires planning for variable supply and demand.

source.en: Comparing complete systems is therefore more informative than judging a technology only by the electricity it produces under ideal conditions.
source.tr: Bu nedenle bütün sistemleri karşılaştırmak, teknolojiyi yalnızca ideal koşullarda ürettiği elektrikle değerlendirmekten daha bilgilendiricidir.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?
questions.answer: A battery can store an unlimited amount of energy.
options: A battery can store an unlimited amount of energy.
